# SYNC Games | Juss & Co.

> Three distinct SYNC experiences built for social play: Live Site SYNC (SYNC Party), Chat SYNC, and Lovable SYNC.

Publisher: Juss & Co. | https://www.jussco.company/
Game hub: https://games.jussco.company/

## Public, citable game pages
- SYNC Party / Live Site SYNC: https://sync.jussco.company/ — real-time multiplayer party game for 2–8 players, timed private picks, room codes, synchronized reveal, no app installation or login.
- Chat SYNC: https://sync.jussco.company/chat/ — AI-hosted chat presentation with local predictions; the prediction is not a game answer or authoritative room state.
- Lovable SYNC: https://sync-playtest.lovable.app/ — social vibe matching and playtest signup; not a claim of full public production gameplay.

## Discovery
- Canonical sitemap: https://sync.jussco.company/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://sync.jussco.company/crawlers.json
- Game family hub: https://games.jussco.company/

## Boundaries
- Search indexing, short attributed citation, and user-directed retrieval of public descriptions are welcome.
- Model training, bulk harvesting, and commercial reuse are not granted.
- Never retrieve private rooms, player answers, tokens, personal data, internal analytics, or operator paths.
- /api/, /control-room*, and /usage* are not public discovery surfaces.
- Robots and discovery documents do not grant authorization or execution authority.
